name: ITSHABBENING
description: ITSHABBENING — private, PII-scrubbed, OPSEC-compliant educational verified-currency for SuperGrok and Grok Tutor. Not generative. Operator-dated facts with limits and sources.

notes.title: Stop if unsafe
notes.statement: If a person could get hurt, stop that path and tell the right lead. Schedule pressure does not override a clear safety problem.
notes.limits: Stop-work authority details are employer- and site-specific.

notes.title: Learning support
notes.statement: Grok Tutor is here to help you learn and practice. For real licensed work, follow your instructors, workplace procedures, and official guidance.
notes.limits: Check what your workplace and instructors expect.

notes.title: Saw / think / guess
notes.statement: Separate what you saw, what you think, and what you are still guessing. Mixing them creates false certainty.
notes.limits: A learning habit—not a legal standard of proof.

notes.title: Minimize personal data in learning chats
notes.statement: Do not paste real patient, student, client, or coworker private identifiers into learning tools. Use synthetic examples.
notes.limits: You control what you type; tools may process chat under their policies when live models are used.

notes.title: Prefer primary public sources
notes.statement: For rules and requirements, prefer primary public documents (code body, agency page, manufacturer instructions) over random social posts.
notes.limits: Links rot; re-verify on review dates.

notes.title: Test before touch
notes.statement: Assume circuits are energized until you verify de-energized state using the site’s approved method (lockout/tagout and test-before-touch). “Someone said it’s off” is not verification.
notes.limits: Exact LOTO steps, PPE, and permit rules are employer- and jurisdiction-specific. Not a substitute for a licensed electrician or site procedure.

notes.title: Clear field update
notes.statement: When something is wrong, tell a lead: where, what you saw, hold or go, and who must decide. Photos help when allowed.
notes.limits: Radio/phone rules and chain of command are site-specific.

notes.title: Credential path — Electrical
notes.statement: Before promising a career outcome in Electrical, check the real credential, license, or apprenticeship path where you live. Requirements differ by region and change over time.
notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Test before conceal
notes.statement: Do not cover drain or supply work until required tests pass and the responsible lead releases the area for cover.
notes.limits: Exact tests and sign-off follow your site process and the people who release cover.

notes.title: Slope and vent matter
notes.statement: Drains need correct slope and a clear vent path so traps hold and waste flows. “Looks fine” is not a measurement.
notes.limits: Code numbers and methods vary by jurisdiction.

notes.title: Refrigerant and power safety
notes.statement: Treat equipment as hazardous for power, moving parts, and refrigerant until trained procedures and required credentials for the task are confirmed. Do not bypass safeties to “just get cooling back.”
notes.limits: EPA/section 608 and local rules apply to refrigerant work; employer SOP governs.

notes.title: Measure, then decide
notes.statement: Capture temperatures, pressures (if qualified), and airflow symptoms before swapping major parts. Guess-and-replace wastes money and can create new faults.
notes.limits: Gauge work requires training and credentials where required.

notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Hot work controls
notes.statement: Before arc or flame: confirm hot-work permission, combustibles cleared or protected, fire watch as required, and PPE for the process. Never weld over unknown coatings or closed vessels without procedure.
notes.limits: Permit systems and fire-watch rules are site-specific.
sources: OSHA hot work / welding hazard awareness (educational)

notes.title: Procedure before improvisation
notes.statement: Follow the welding procedure specification for the joint. Random settings “that worked last time” are not a procedure.
notes.limits: WPS/PQR requirements are code- and employer-specific.

notes.title: Stop for uncontrolled change
notes.statement: When plans, site conditions, or safety controls do not match, stop and escalate. Do not invent a field fix that hides a coordination or structural risk.
notes.limits: Change-order authority and RFI process are contract-specific.

notes.title: Write the constraint
notes.statement: If two trades conflict, write the constraint (who, where, when, drawing reference) so the next decision is informed.
notes.limits: Contract roles differ by project.

notes.title: Load path and temporary support
notes.statement: Do not remove structural members or temporary bracing without an approved plan. Gravity does not wait for a second opinion.
notes.limits: Engineering direction is required for structural alterations.
sources: Basic framing / temporary support safety awareness (educational)

notes.title: Layout twice
notes.statement: Verify layout against plan dimensions before cutting expensive members. Mark waste clearly.
notes.limits: Plan hold status and RFIs may change dimensions.

notes.title: Escalate patient change
notes.statement: If breathing, mentation, pain, or vitals trend worsen, reassess and escalate per unit protocol. Do not wait for someone else to notice.
notes.limits: Not medical advice. Scope of practice and protocols are license- and facility-specific.

notes.title: Closed-loop communication
notes.statement: Read back critical verbal orders and confirm who owns the next action. Ambiguous “someone will…” is not a plan.
notes.limits: Facility communication policies govern.

notes.title: Scene safety first
notes.statement: Do not enter an unsafe scene. Make the scene as safe as practical, request resources, and follow medical direction and protocols for your certification level.
notes.limits: Not medical direction. Local protocols and medical control govern.

notes.title: Handoff structure
notes.statement: Give receiving staff a short structured handoff: age/sex if known, chief concern, findings, treatments, response, and open questions.
notes.limits: Local handoff formats vary.

notes.title: Right drug, right patient, right check
notes.statement: Verify identity, drug, dose, route, and timing against the order and policy before dispensing or administering. Interruptions are a known error risk—reset the check.
notes.limits: Not medical or dispensing authority. Facility policy and license rules control.

notes.title: Allergy and interaction pause
notes.statement: Pause for allergy and interaction checks flagged by system or history. Clarify with prescriber/pharmacist per policy—do not override casually.
notes.limits: Clinical decision support rules are system-specific.

notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Don’t ship untested critical paths
notes.statement: Before release, verify the change with tests or a clear checklist for the critical path. “It works on my machine” is not a release criterion for production.
notes.limits: Org CI/CD and change-management rules vary.

notes.title: Small diffs, clear intent
notes.statement: Prefer small changes with a clear purpose and a way to roll back. Large mystery commits create outages.
notes.limits: Team branching models differ.

notes.title: Least privilege and no shared admin
notes.statement: Grant only needed access; remove access when roles end. Shared admin accounts and permanent elevated rights create lasting risk.
notes.limits: Protective concept only—not an attack tutorial.

notes.title: Log enough to learn
notes.statement: Keep simple, time-stamped records of access changes and security-relevant events so incidents can be reconstructed without guessing.
notes.limits: Retention and monitoring tools are org-specific.

notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Reproduce, then change
notes.statement: Reproduce the issue and capture facts before major changes. Document what you did so the next tech is not guessing.
notes.limits: Ticket systems and escalation paths are org-specific.

notes.title: Password resets with identity proof
notes.statement: Reset credentials only after identity checks required by policy. Social engineering often starts with urgency and name-dropping.
notes.limits: Identity proofing steps are org-specific.

notes.title: Define the question before the number
notes.statement: Write the decision question and metric definition before querying. Wrong filters and silent missing data create confident false stories.
notes.limits: Governance and privacy rules are org- and law-specific.

notes.title: Show the grain and filter
notes.statement: State the data grain, date range, and major filters with every number. Otherwise people compare unlike things.
notes.limits: Warehouse semantics are org-specific.

notes.title: Secure work and prove offsets
notes.statement: Secure the workpiece, verify tools and offsets, and keep hands clear of motion paths. Prove the first article before a production run.
notes.limits: Machine-specific procedures and guarding rules apply.

notes.title: First article before batch
notes.statement: Inspect the first part against print critical dimensions before running a full batch.
notes.limits: Sampling plans are org-specific.

notes.title: Stop escape of defects
notes.statement: When a defect could reach a customer or create a safety issue, contain first, then analyze. Do not “ship and sort later” for safety-critical issues.
notes.limits: Quality system procedures are org-specific.

notes.title: Write the nonconformance clearly
notes.statement: Record requirement, actual, quantity, and disposition path. Vague NCRs cannot be fixed or trended.
notes.limits: QMS forms differ.

notes.title: Credential path — Quality Assurance

notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Separate duties and support entries
notes.statement: Keep recording, custody, and approval appropriately separated where possible. Every material entry should have support you can re-find later.
notes.limits: Not CPA advice. GAAP/IFRS and tax rules require qualified professionals.

notes.title: Reconcile to the source
notes.statement: Tie balances to source systems or statements. Unexplained plugs hide errors and fraud risk.
notes.limits: Not audit or tax advice.

notes.title: Credential path — Accounting

notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Truthful commitments
notes.statement: Do not promise delivery, features, or pricing you cannot support. Document what the customer was told.
notes.limits: Contract and compliance rules are company- and jurisdiction-specific.

notes.title: CRM truthfulness
notes.statement: Log stage and next step honestly. Fake pipeline hides forecast risk.
notes.limits: CRM fields are company-specific.

notes.title: Surface risk early
notes.statement: Write risks and blockers while there is still time to act. Silent schedule hope is not a plan.
notes.limits: Methodology (Agile/waterfall) varies by org.

notes.title: Single source of schedule truth
notes.statement: Keep one agreed schedule artifact. Side spreadsheets without owners create false confidence.
notes.limits: Tooling varies.

notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Time and temperature
notes.statement: Keep cold foods cold and hot foods hot per policy. Separate raw and ready-to-eat paths. When time/temp control is lost, follow discard or corrective rules—do not guess.
notes.limits: Health department codes and restaurant SOPs govern.

notes.title: Allergy communication
notes.statement: Treat allergy requests as safety-critical. Confirm ingredients and cross-contact risk; do not guess.
notes.limits: Menu systems and labeling laws vary.

notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Guest safety and honesty
notes.statement: If a guest could be harmed (allergy, wet floor, security issue), act and escalate. Do not hide service failures that create risk.
notes.limits: Brand standards and local law vary.

notes.title: Service recovery with ownership
notes.statement: Acknowledge the issue, state what you will do, and give a time or owner. Empty apologies without action erode trust.
notes.limits: Compensation authority is brand-specific.

notes.title: Credential path — Hospitality
notes.statement: Before promising a career outcome in Hospitality, check the real credential, license, or apprenticeship path where you live. Requirements differ by region and change over time.
notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Lawful authority and reporting truth
notes.statement: Act only within legal authority and policy. Report what you observed, what you did, and what remains unknown—without inventing facts.
notes.limits: Educational only—not legal advice or tactics training. Agency policy and law control.

notes.title: Contemporaneous notes
notes.statement: Record important observations close to the time of the event. Memory decays; invented detail is misconduct.
notes.limits: Agency report systems govern.

notes.title: Credential path — Law Enforcement
notes.statement: Before promising a career outcome in Law Enforcement, check the real credential, license, or apprenticeship path where you live. Requirements differ by region and change over time.
notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Student safety and accurate records
notes.statement: Protect student safety and privacy. Keep grades and incident notes factual and timely. Escalate safeguarding concerns per required channels.
notes.limits: FERPA/state rules and district policy govern; not legal advice.

notes.title: Document behavior factually
notes.statement: Describe observable behavior and time, not labels or insults. Facts support fair follow-up.
notes.limits: District forms and laws apply.

notes.title: Credential path — Teaching

notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Hours, inspection, and impairment
notes.statement: Do not drive impaired or past legal hours-of-service limits. Complete required inspections and report defects that make the vehicle unsafe.
notes.limits: FMCSA and carrier policies control; this is educational awareness.

notes.title: Pre-trip is not optional
notes.statement: Complete required pre-trip checks. Defects that affect control, tires, lights, or securement must be addressed before travel.
notes.limits: CVSA/FMCSA details are regulatory—verify current rules.

notes.title: Credential path — CDL / Trucking
notes.statement: Before promising a career outcome in CDL / Trucking, check the real credential, license, or apprenticeship path where you live. Requirements differ by region and change over time.
notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Checklist and go/no-go discipline
notes.statement: Use required checklists. If a limit, weather, or maintenance item is outside approved bounds, do not “push on” without the proper authority and procedure.
notes.limits: FARs, ops specs, and aircraft manuals govern. Not flight instruction.

notes.title: Brief the threats
notes.statement: Before flight or maintenance task, brief the main threats and mitigations for this day—not a generic speech.
notes.limits: Ops manuals define briefing standards.

notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Accessibility and truth in presentation
notes.statement: Design so critical information is readable and usable. Do not hide material limitations in fine print users cannot reasonably use.
notes.limits: WCAG/legal requirements vary by product and region.

notes.title: Design for the worst readable case
notes.statement: Check critical text and controls at small sizes and poor lighting. Pretty mockups can hide unusable UI.
notes.limits: Platform guidelines vary.

notes.title: Credential path — Design

notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Consent, safety, and credits
notes.statement: Get needed permissions for people and locations. Keep sets safe (power, rigging, traffic). Credit sources honestly; do not present others’ work as yours.
notes.limits: Release forms and union/rules are production-specific.

notes.title: Shot list before roll
notes.statement: Arrive with a shot list and audio plan. Rolling without intent burns time and misses coverage.
notes.limits: Documentary vs scripted workflows differ.

notes.title: Credential path — Video Production
notes.statement: Before promising a career outcome in Video Production, check the real credential, license, or apprenticeship path where you live. Requirements differ by region and change over time.
notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Energy isolation
notes.statement: Before service, isolate hazardous energy (electrical, pressure, mechanical) per procedure and verify zero energy state. Never defeat interlocks casually.
notes.limits: Plant procedures and LOTO programs are site-specific.

notes.title: Permit to work awareness
notes.statement: High-risk tasks often need a permit-to-work. Starting without required permits is a process failure, not heroism.
notes.limits: Permit systems are site-specific.

notes.title: Credential path — Energy & Utilities
notes.statement: Before promising a career outcome in Energy & Utilities, check the real credential, license, or apprenticeship path where you live. Requirements differ by region and change over time.
notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Machine and chemical caution
notes.statement: Shut down and secure equipment before clearing jams. Follow label and PPE rules for chemicals. Fatigue and rush harvests raise injury risk.
notes.limits: EPA labels and farm SOPs govern chemical use.

notes.title: Guard and PTO caution
notes.statement: Keep guards in place. PTO and pinch points injure quickly—shut down before clearing.
notes.limits: Equipment manuals govern.

notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Support the vehicle, control energy
notes.statement: Support vehicles with approved stands—not jacks alone. Disconnect or isolate energy as required before work that could move parts or airbags.
notes.limits: OEM procedures and shop policy control.

notes.title: Torque critical fasteners
notes.statement: Use specified torque on critical fasteners (wheels, suspension, engine). Guessing torque creates comebacks and hazards.
notes.limits: OEM specs control.

notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Load securement and fatigue
notes.statement: Secure loads per rule and inspect before travel. Do not accept fatigue or damaged equipment as “normal.” Report issues that affect public roads.
notes.limits: DOT and carrier rules apply.

notes.title: Dock and pedestrian awareness
notes.statement: Control trailer creep, chock as required, and watch for pedestrians on docks. Speed in yards is a safety control.
notes.limits: Yard rules are site-specific.

notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Primary sources and jurisdiction
notes.statement: Prefer primary public records and state the jurisdiction. Separate what the document says from what you infer. Do not dox private individuals.
notes.limits: Not legal advice. Public-records rules vary by state.

notes.title: Cite the document
notes.statement: When making a public claim, cite the document type, date, and jurisdiction. Screenshots without provenance are weak evidence.
notes.limits: Not legal advice.

notes.title: Credential path — Civic Intelligence
notes.statement: Before promising a career outcome in Civic Intelligence, check the real credential, license, or apprenticeship path where you live. Requirements differ by region and change over time.
notes.limits: Not career counseling or a guarantee of employment. Confirm with official boards, unions, or schools.

notes.title: Claim hygiene
notes.statement: Label evidence vs inference vs assumption. Check who benefits from a frame. Do not amplify unverified harm claims as fact.
notes.limits: Educational media literacy—not a newsroom policy.

notes.title: Slow the share
notes.statement: Before resharing shocking claims, check original source, date, and whether the clip is cropped to change meaning.
notes.limits: Educational habit—not platform policy.
